<P align=justify>The undersigned, Robert Burden, Chief Executive Officer and
Chief Financial Officer of Playbox (US) Inc. (the &#147;<B>Company</B>&#148;), hereby
certifies, pursuant to 18 U.S.C. Section 1350, as adopted pursuant to Section
906 of the Sarbanes-Oxley Act of 2002, that the Quarterly Report on Form 10-Q of
the Company for the quarter ended March 31, 2008 fully complies with the
requirements of Section 13(a) or 15(d) of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934,
and that the information contained in the Quarterly Report on Form 10-Q fairly
presents in all material respects the financial condition and results of
operations of the Company. </P>
<P align=justify>Date: May 15, 2008</P>
